lucy: Heads-up: onboarding sample app crashes on async tool/function calls when tools return dataclasses. Repro with redwood==0.14.2.

lucy: Minimal repro (async):
```py
from dataclasses import dataclass
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(api_key=ENV_TOKEN)
@dataclass
class Thing:
    id: int
    label: str
async def main():
    return await client.call_tool(name='parse_thing', input={'raw':'1 Widget'}, response_schema=Thing)
```

sam: What error do you get?

lucy: TypeError: Failed to coerce dataclass to json in redwood/_struct.py — only on async path, sync client fine.

kyle-devex: Likely known: async coercer runs in ThreadPoolExecutor and our serializer hooks for dataclasses aren't propagated. Also saw a related flake where a token refresh + retry suppression surfaces as a serialization error.

anya: Short-term workaround: convert to dict in the tool (asdict). Not great for onboarding because editors/mypy show different types.

kyle-devex: Plan: patch async coercer to run on event loop (or propagate hooks), harden token-refresh retry for toolcall, add CI e2e matrix (sync/async x dataclass/dict), and cut 0.14.3 hotfix. I'll open PR and add changelog.

lucy: Can you add a docs note recommending dict return until the patch ships? New devs keep getting confused.

kyle-devex: Yep 100. Will update sample-app README and docs with workaround and link this thread.

ci-bot: build/sample-app (python-matrix) queued -> job #5012

lucy: Thanks 60a will validate the hotfix when available.
